title: The adaptive immunity and the incidence of SARS-CoV-2 infection in employees with occupational risk of infection taking into account physical fitness
summary: The aim of the present occupational immunological study is to investigate the acquired immune response in employees with regard to the incidence of SARS-CoV-2 infections with the currently dominant variants and their sublines, taking into account physical activity in critical infrastructure facilities and companies at several locations in the Federal Republic of Germany.

interventions.name: The population was defined as the population subject to social insurance contributions in Germany aged 18 and over (n=300-1000)  working in critical infrastructure facilities and companies in the Federal Republic of Germany with a high occupational risk of SARS-CoV-2 infection with the variants of c

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Employees are recruited who are exposed to a high risk of infection with relevant SARS-CoV-2 variants due to their professional activities in facilities and have been immunized.
Exclusion criteria:
Non aplicable.
